name: Apple Education Store
description: Education pricing on Mac and iPad for students and educators
fullDescription: Apple offers education pricing on Mac and iPad for current and newly accepted college students, their parents, and faculty and staff, plus homeschool teachers of all grade levels.
whatTheyOffer:
- Education pricing on Mac and iPad
- Apple Music Student plan at a reduced monthly price
- Back to School promotion (summer): Apple Gift Card of up to $150 with an eligible Mac or iPad
howToGetIt:
1. Visit apple.com/us-edu/store
2. Verify your eligibility when prompted
3. College students (current or newly accepted), parents buying for them, and faculty/staff qualify
4. Homeschool teachers of all grade levels also eligible
5. Discounted prices shown in the Education Store
keywords: Apple, student discount, education discount, college, university, teacher, Mac, MacBook, iPad, back to school
